learningCandidates.summary: microblog API blueprint: new endpoints need import added in app/api/__init__.py
learningCandidates.content: New REST endpoint modules under app/api/ (e.g. posts.py) are only wired up if imported at the bottom of app/api/__init__.py (e.g. 'from app.api import users, posts, errors, tokens'). Forgetting this import means the route is never registered on the blueprint despite @bp.route decorators being present.
appliesWhen: Adding a new API endpoint module under app/api/
limitations: Specific to this Flask blueprint pattern (app/api)
reusableFor: Adding future REST endpoints in app/api

learningCandidates.summary: Post.timestamp from SQLite is naive UTC; must add tzinfo for ISO 8601 +00:00 offset output
learningCandidates.content: Post.timestamp is stored via datetime.now(timezone.utc) but SQLAlchemy/SQLite strips tzinfo on retrieval, returning a naive datetime. isoformat() on it omits the UTC offset. To produce ISO 8601 strings with an explicit +00:00 offset in API responses, call timestamp.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc) before isoformat(). app/tasks.py works around the same issue by appending 'Z' manually instead.
appliesWhen: Serializing Post.timestamp (or similar UTC-default datetime columns) to JSON/ISO strings
limitations: Observed with default sqlite:// test DB; other DB backends may preserve tzinfo differently
reusableFor: Any API or export code formatting Post/Message/Notification timestamps
